editorialHtml.en:
DeepSeek is listed because I occasionally test open-weight style chat and API pricing pages when updating the tools directory—not because it powers this static site. Bookmark entry on aogl.cn only.

My actual use

  • Compare reasoning style on a short coding question before I document another tool guide.
  • Read release notes linked from aggregators—then verify on DeepSeek’s own domain.
  • Never paste production secrets or visitor data.

Compared to ChatGPT / Claude

I keep all three bookmarks. DeepSeek is for cross-checking answers on technical snippets; Claude still drafts long English article paragraphs; ChatGPT is the OpenAI surface I use for plugin ecosystem questions.

Maintenance

  1. Open official site below.
  2. Note model name and date in my private changelog if directory copy changes.
  3. Update this page’s updated field when I re-verify links.

News summaries may appear in briefs when synced from other labs—DeepSeek-specific posts depend on official RSS I choose to mirror.
editorialHtml.zh:
DeepSeek 列入目录是因为更新工具列表时会偶尔测试开放权重风格对话与 API 定价页——并不驱动本静态站。仅是 aogl.cn 书签。

实际用法

  • 写另一篇 tool-guide 前用短代码题对比回答风格。
  • 从聚合站看到发布后回官网核对。
  • 不贴生产密钥或访客数据。

与 ChatGPT / Claude

三者书签都保留。DeepSeek 用于交叉核对技术片段；Claude 仍写长英文段落；ChatGPT 用于 OpenAI 生态问题。

维护

  1. 从下方官网进入。
  2. 若改目录文案，在私人 changelog 记模型名与日期。
  3. 重新核对链接时更新本页 updated。

其它实验室快讯见 briefs。
